frame_cpu_ms.note: the thread's CPU time per frame: the work without the waiting; a hitch in frame_ms that is not here was a stall (descheduled or paged), not computed

h_live.note: bits of live distinguishing information gained per game-second (operational proposal, lab 20261007-2057-spacex-de6a): the empirical conditional entropy of the canonical word deltas (tube key, wrapping angle, periapsis time, two carries) at the apply funnel, per (kind, body); all-zero-delta events store nothing; births are the program's; decisions counted separately; the fleet members' internal lattice carries are not counted
